_note: Curated portfolio projects for the 4 verified roles. Every source_id is registered in docs/source-register.md (URL and licence checked on checked_at). estimated_hours is always a team estimate: the sum of the per-milestone hours in hours_basis_note. No project is described as trending (we have no signal evidence for that). Datasets are linked, never copied into this app.

projects.title: Online retail sales dashboard
projects.expected_outcome: A dashboard of monthly revenue, top products and returns, plus a one-page findings note.
milestones: Load and clean the data (remove cancellations and blank customer IDs)
Write SQL queries for monthly revenue and the top 10 products
Analyse returns and cancellations
Build a Power BI dashboard
Write a one-page findings note

projects.title: Bank marketing campaign analysis
projects.expected_outcome: Conversion rates by customer segment, with recommendations and clearly stated limits.
milestones: Explore the dataset's rows and fields
Write SQL for conversion rates by job, month and contact type
Chart the segments
Identify likely drivers and note possible confounders
Write a short recommendation memo

projects.title: Macroeconomic comparison workbook
projects.expected_outcome: An Excel workbook comparing GDP growth and inflation for 5 countries, refreshed and formatted by a VBA macro.
milestones: Download GDP growth and inflation indicators for 5 countries, 2000 to the latest year
Clean the data in Excel with check formulas
Calculate growth rates and inflation-adjusted values
Write a VBA macro that refreshes and formats the comparison sheet
Build a chart dashboard
Write a short comparison memo

projects.title: Credit card default risk analysis
projects.expected_outcome: Default rates by credit limit and repayment history, and a simple Excel risk score that does not use sex, marital status or age.
milestones: Load the data into SQL or Excel and check every field against the data dictionary
Calculate default rates by credit-limit band and by recent repayment status
Build pivot tables and charts of the results
Build a simple Excel risk score using only repayment and balance fields (exclude sex, marital status and age)
Check how well the score separates defaulters and write up its limits
projects.data_note: The dataset includes sex, marital status and age columns; the project deliberately leaves them out of the risk score.

projects.title: Machine failure analysis
projects.expected_outcome: A notebook explaining machine failure modes, with a simple, evaluated failure classifier.
milestones: Load the data
Explore the different failure types
Build features in Python (for example torque times tool wear)
Fit a threshold rule and a logistic regression model
Evaluate the models and explain their errors

projects.title: Power plant output model in MATLAB
projects.expected_outcome: A MATLAB regression of power output from ambient conditions, with a physical interpretation of the results.
milestones: Import the data into MATLAB
Plot each ambient variable against power output
Fit a linear regression model
Test the model on held-out data and report the error
Summarise the results in Excel
Explain the results physically

projects.title: Parametric bracket and assembly in CAD
projects.expected_outcome: A parametric bracket with size variants, a small assembly and a dimensioned 2D drawing.
milestones: Sketch the bracket profile with constraints
Build the parametric part
Create size variants using variables
Assemble the bracket with fasteners
Produce a dimensioned 2D drawing

projects.title: Hospital readmission patterns (diabetes)
projects.expected_outcome: Readmission rates by patient group, with a significance test and clear observational-data caveats.
milestones: Load the data
Clean the missing-value codes
Write SQL for readmission rates by age band and admission type
Compare groups statistically in Python
Chart the results and write a caveats section
projects.data_note: The dataset is de-identified, public and licensed CC BY 4.0. No part of it is included in this app; the project only links to the UCI page.

projects.title: Health spending vs outcomes across countries
projects.expected_outcome: Trend charts and a correlation analysis of health spending and outcomes, stating clearly that correlation is not causation.
milestones: Choose 3 health indicators for 10 countries
Clean the data in Excel
Calculate correlations and draw scatter plots in Python
Chart the trends over time
Write up the limitations

projects.title: Web dashboard for World Bank indicators
projects.expected_outcome: A small browser app that loads World Bank indicator data and charts it, kept in a Git repository with a clear history.
milestones: Download 3 indicators for 5 countries as CSV
Set up a Git repository with a README and a branch per feature
Write JavaScript that loads and parses the CSV
Draw line charts in the browser
Add input checks and friendly error messages
Publish the page and document how to run it

projects.title: Command-line sales report tool in Python
projects.expected_outcome: A tested Python command-line tool that loads retail transactions into SQLite and prints sales reports.
milestones: Design the command-line options and data model
Load the data into SQLite with Python
Write SQL queries for the reports
Write unit tests for loading and reports
Use Git branches and pull requests for each feature
Write usage documentation

projects.title: One month of books for a fictional small business in GnuCash
projects.expected_outcome: A complete, reconciled month of bookkeeping for a made-up business, with an income statement and balance sheet.
milestones: Set up a chart of accounts for a fictional shop
Enter one month of fictional transactions
Reconcile the bank account
Run the income statement and balance sheet reports
Export to Excel and check every total
projects.data_note: Uses fictional transactions the student makes up; no real company or personal data.

projects.title: Monthly revenue reconciliation
projects.expected_outcome: A monthly net-revenue ledger that separates sales from cancellations and is cross-checked two ways.
milestones: Load the invoice data
Separate sales from cancellations (invoice codes starting with 'C')
Build a monthly net revenue ledger in Excel
Cross-check the Excel totals with SQL
Investigate the 10 largest adjustments
Write a short reconciliation note

projects.title: Concrete strength vs mix design
projects.expected_outcome: A MATLAB model of concrete compressive strength from mix ingredients and age, with an engineering interpretation.
milestones: Import the data into MATLAB
Explore how age and the water-to-cement ratio affect strength
Fit a regression model in MATLAB
Test the model on held-out data
Build a mix-design summary table in Excel
Explain the results in engineering terms

projects.title: Site suitability analysis in QGIS
projects.expected_outcome: A site-suitability map built by following the QGIS Training Manual's vector modules, with stated criteria.
milestones: Work through the 'Creating and Exploring a Basic Map' module
Work through the 'Classifying Vector Data' and 'Creating Vector Data' modules
Run the analysis in the 'Vector Analysis' module
Lay out the final map ('Laying out the Maps' module)
Write up the selection criteria and assumptions

projects.title: Air pollution and weather across 12 Beijing monitoring sites
projects.expected_outcome: Seasonal pollutant trends for 12 monitoring sites and how they relate to weather, with clear limits on what the data can show.
milestones: Combine the 12 site files and handle missing values (marked NA)
Calculate daily and monthly averages of PM2.5 and NO2 for each site
Compare pollutant levels with wind speed, rain and temperature
Chart the seasonal trends and compare the sites
Write up the limitations: one city, March 2013 to February 2017 only, and correlation is not cause
projects.data_note: Licensed CC BY 4.0, as stated on the UCI page, with no extra use restriction. Credit the creator (Song Chen) and UCI. No part of the dataset is included in this app; the project only links to the UCI page.

projects.title: Forestry mapping in QGIS
projects.expected_outcome: A forest map and summary produced by following the QGIS Training Manual's Forestry Application module.
milestones: Work through the 'Creating and Exploring a Basic Map' module
Work through the 'Forestry Application' module with its sample data
Summarise the module's results in a table
Lay out the final map
Write up the limitations
